purpose: Preview-only characters-combat style board for selecting a tactical graphic illustration direction before producing the player master asset.
facing: right-facing neutral masters in a fixed comparison grid
lighting: controlled cyan rim light, restrained magenta bounce, warm orange weapon and impact emission
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: preview-only 2D game character style board. Create four isolated subjects in a clean fixed 2x2 comparison grid on a flat low-contrast black-blue field: top-left a compact player operative with cyan faction light and a separate warm-orange rifle; top-right a smaller Scrapper enemy with angular magenta salvage armor; bottom-left a massive Bruiser enemy with broad dark ceramic plates and restrained magenta energy; bottom-right a compact orange-white radial hit spark. Style direction A: bold tactical graphic illustration, chunky readable shapes, precise hard-surface planes, restrained hand-painted cel shading, crisp silhouettes, minimal micro-detail. Consistent top-down three-quarter camera and neutral right-facing pose for all actors. No labels, no text, no borders, no scenery, no cropped anatomy, no loose cables, no acid green, no excessive bloom, no watermark.
negative_constraints: no acid green in this preview
no excessive bloom or opaque halos
